VMX initializes the TSC offset for each vcpu at different times
also reinitializes it for vcpus other than 0 on APIC SIPI message.
This bug causes the TSC's to appear unsynchronized in the guest
Older Linux kernels don't handle the situation very well
gettimeofday is likely to go backwards in time:
Fix it by initializating the offset of each vcpu relative to vm creation

column2: and moving it from vmx_vcpu_reset to vmx_vcpu_setup
